description: ACS712-05B current sensor: ADC1 IN0 (PA0) averaged over 16 conversions every 200 ms, I = (mV - 2500) / 0.185, prints 'I=<mA> mA (out <mV> mV)' on USART1
expect: 72 MHz, ADCCLK 12 MHz. ADC1 independent, single conversion, software start, channel 0 (PA0 analog) sampled 239.5 cycles, calibrated with HAL_ADCEx_Calibration_Start. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Boot: 'ACS712-05B on PA0: 2500 mV = 0 A, 185 mV/A\r\n'. Every 200 ms (first right after boot) 16 conversions are summed; mV = round(sum x 3300 / (16 x 4095)), I = round((mV - 2500) x 1000 / 185) mA, printed as 'I=<mA> mA (out <mV> mV)\r\n', with ' (ADC full scale)' appended when every sample read 4094 or more (OUT above 3.3 V: currents above about +4.3 A). PA0 at 0 V reads 'I=-13514 mA (out 0 mV)'.

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
PA0: 10k ohm pull-down to GND (tests/devices/sensors-firmware.test.ts wires an ACS712 module instead)

boot.USART1:
ACS712-05B on PA0: 2500 mV = 0 A, 185 mV/A
I=-13514 mA (out 0 mV)
